cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

mechanism: A uses precise soup-tasting procedure and corrective expertise to generate another necessary check whenever B tries to leave, never asking directly for company.
confusable: Generic hospitality lacks the professional correction that turns B answers into further required checks.
comparison: Jam alternative makes packing competence the reason for delay instead of repeated quality assurance.
seedUse: Soup seed provides salt and train deadline; S03 should find the next obligation in a plausible tasting error rather than bolt on unrelated bread.
